note: Open seat: Sen. Steve Daines (R) withdrew on March 4, 2026 and endorsed Alme. Also on ballot: Kyle Austin (L).

cands.name: Kurt Alme
cands.desc: Former U.S. Attorney for Montana and state budget director under Gov. Gianforte; runs on veterans, Second Amendment, keeping boys out of girls' sports, public lands and election security; endorsed by Sen. Steve Daines.

cands.name: Alani Bankhead
cands.desc: Retired Air Force lieutenant colonel and counterintelligence agent, life-coaching business founder; runs on housing, health care and government accountability.

cands.name: Seth Bodnar
cands.desc: Former University of Montana president, Army Green Beret and GE executive; running as an independent, arguing both major parties have failed Montana.
